theorems.name: Submission.rectifiable_c1_chart_pieces
theorems.statement: SubmanifoldCoverCharacterization → (∀ (n p : ℕ) (f : Rn n → Rn p) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ g : Rn n → Rn p, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ volume {x | f x ≠ g x ∨ fderiv ℝ f x ≠ fderiv ℝ g x} < ε) → ∀ (n ℓ m : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn (n + ℓ))) (f : Rn (n + ℓ) → Rn m), CountablyRectifiable n M → IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → ∃ (D : ℕ → Set (Rn n)) (ψ : ℕ → Rn n → Rn (n + ℓ)) (G : ℕ → Rn n → Rn m) (E : ℕ → Set (Rn n)), (∀ j, IsOpen (D j)) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (ψ j) (D j)) ∧ (∀ j, InjOn (ψ j) (D j)) ∧ (∀ j, ∃ K, LipschitzOnWith K (ψ j) (D j)) ∧ (∀ j, ∀ u ∈ D j, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) u)) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (G j)) ∧ (∀ j, MeasurableSet (E j)) ∧ (∀ j, E j ⊆ D j) ∧ (∀ j, ∀ u ∈ E j, f (ψ j u) = G j u ∧ HasFDerivAt (f ∘ ψ j) (fderiv ℝ (G j) u) u) ∧ μHE[n] (M \ ⋃ j, ψ j '' E j) = 0
